text:
Sam: Heads-up — planning soft swap from blue -> green for release v2.3.0 tonight at 21:00 PT. Will follow the staged weight plan below. Link to release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2.3.0 :rocket:
Priya: Ack. What's the weight cadence and hold windows? Also confirm session cookie TTL/affinity behavior for this build.
Diego: Proposed cadence: 0 -> 10 -> 25 -> 50 -> 75 -> 100, holds: 5m, 5m, 10m, 10m, 5m. Rollback faster if error spike.
Sam: That matches what I had in the playbook. We'll start with a small cohort (10%) in us-west-2 only, verify traces and cache hit ratio before regional expansion.
Priya: Session affinity: v2.3 keeps cookie name `rw_session` but we toggled `sticky_session=false` for router v4.2, so affinity is best-effort via cookie — we should expect some re-routes. TTL is 30m.
Jen: Rollback criteria I want on the table: >1% 5m error rate for 2 consecutive windows OR sustained p95 latency > 500ms for 3 mins OR user-visible regressions reported by QA. If any of those hit, trigger immediate 30% rollback and notify oncall.
Sam: Agreed. Add monitoring thresholds to deploy job. Diego, can deploy-bot watch for those and annotate the thread?
Diego: @deploy-bot will watch. Config snippet I'm adding to the job:```yaml
watchers:
  - metric: http_error_rate
    window: 5m
    threshold: 0.01
    action: rollback_partial
  - metric: p95_latency_ms
    window: 3m
    threshold: 500
    action: rollback_partial
```
deploy-bot: Deployment plan received. Will post stage updates and call `routerctl` steps. Starting when Sam says `go`.
Priya: One more: cache warming — please run the smoke generator against green at 10% weight for the first 5m to prime KV caches. That should mitigate cold-start latency.
Sam: Will do. Smoke load command (devex): `./scripts/smoke.sh --target green --qps 50 --duration 300`
Diego: Router commands for each step (ops):```bash
# set 10%
routerctl traffic set-weight --from blue --to green --weight 10 --region us-west-2
# verify
routerctl traffic status --region us-west-2
```
Sam: I'll run the first step at 21:00 PT. tagging the release channel and oncall: @Oncall Bot please escalate to Pager duty on the criteria above.
Oncall Bot: Received. Will page if watchers fire. Also creating a short-lived incident channel: #inc-179555-23 (auto).
Priya: After 50% hold and validation, we can do a global ramp if no issues. Keep runtime config pinned: green image tag `v2.3.0-20260321-ops` — don't rotate during the window.
Jen: Confirmed pin. Also, mark the DB migration as backward compatible — no lockstep needed. QA will be monitoring feature flags in case we need kill-switch.
Diego: I'll leave a safety gate: if any region hit thresholds, we auto-shrink to 25% and then to 0 over 2 minutes. Code in deploy job uses `rollback_partial` action to drive that.
Sam: Timeline summary: 21:00 start (us-west-2 10%), 21:05 -> 25%, 21:10 -> 50% (10m hold), 21:20 -> 75%, 21:30 -> 100% region, then global ramp. All holds manual-advance except automatic rollback triggers.
Priya: :thumbsup: I'll monitor traces and cache hit ratio. Diego will watch infra metrics. Jen on QA. Sam will operate the router steps.
Jen: Quick note — I'll open a short eval run for the top-200 prompt set against green at 25% to watch generation quality drift.
deploy-bot: Starting scheduled watch at 21:00 PT. Posting checkpoints here as each weight change completes.
Sam: Ok all — final checks: release notes link posted, version pinned, smoke command ready, rollback thresholds set. If no objections I'll say `go` at 20:58 PT to allow a 2m preflight.
Priya: No objections from infra.
Diego: Ops ready.
Jen: QA ready.
Sam: go
deploy-bot: STEP: set-weight 10% -> green (us-west-2) — running.```
